concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-payment-method-delete-node]] - Node.js token-based payment-method deletion, with immediate cancellation of every associated subscription and forfeiture of already-paid remaining days
warnings: Keep the destructive effects prominent: the page states that all subscriptions associated with the deleted payment method are canceled immediately and the customer forfeits remaining days already paid for.
Do not broaden this short Node.js reference into claims about refunds, proration, recovery, response semantics, or payment-method deletion in other SDKs.
